steps.label: The gene
steps.why: The gene watches the DNA for damage before the cell is allowed to divide.
common_mistakes: Leaving out that it suppresses tumours.
steps.memory_tip: p53 guards the genome, so it is a tumour suppressing gene.
steps.margin_note: Name it, then explain the name.

steps.label: What it does
steps.why: By halting the cycle at the G₁ check point it gives the cell time to repair itself before dividing.
common_mistakes: Saying it repairs the DNA itself. It stops the cycle so repair can happen.
steps.memory_tip: It stops the cell cycle at the G₁ check point.
steps.margin_note: Name the check point. It is the marked detail.

lines.text: It stops the cycle at G₁ to allow repair
